answer: Each bonded identity posts collateral in an escrow, and cryptographic evidence of coordinated equivocation links the identities. For k identities, pairwise correlations expose O(k²) culpable pairs, so slashing rises quadratically; asymmetric depreciation then compounds the forfeiture, imposing an exponential multiplier on a detected sybil swarm’s capital loss. A quartz grove may hide many agents, but the kernel of shared control makes their correlated signatures costly to conceal.
